home.launch.subtitle: Select account, version and Java runtime before launching.
home.launch.stop_confirm: This will terminate the currently running game process. Continue?
home.accounts.title: Accounts
home.accounts.delete_confirm: Delete cannot be undone. Click delete again to confirm.
home.accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Start with an offline account.
home.accounts.add_subtitle: Bring offline, Microsoft and third-party account entry points into one dialog.
home.accounts.source.offline_steve: Defaults to a random skin slot
home.accounts.offline.description: Enter a player name, choose a skin preset, and Zeperion Launcher will generate a unique random UUID for you.
home.accounts.offline.summary: Local-only and fast to create. Usernames must stay unique while UUIDs are generated automatically.
home.accounts.offline.preview_hint: The offline preview stays visible while the form scrolls on the right.
home.accounts.offline.preview_body: The preview updates instantly from the current name and skin preset, and creation always uses a unique UUID.
home.accounts.offline.preview_title: This is how the offline identity will appear in game
home.accounts.offline.username_hint: This name must be unique in the account list and will be selected immediately after creation.
home.accounts.offline.skin_hint: Skin presets affect the offline presentation only and do not change authentication.
home.accounts.offline.uuid_auto_hint: Creation always generates a unique UUID. If a collision happens, Zeperion Launcher regenerates it automatically.
home.accounts.microsoft.description: Keeps the authorization-code flow and device-code fallback in the UI.
home.accounts.microsoft.summary: Best for official accounts. A Microsoft Client ID is required before the browser-based sign-in can start.
home.accounts.microsoft.flow_summary: Use browser callbacks for the main path and keep device code as fallback.
home.accounts.microsoft.preview_hint: This area will hold the Microsoft login flow notes and future status.
home.accounts.microsoft.client_id_ready_: A Microsoft Client ID was detected, so authorization can start right away.
home.accounts.microsoft.client_id_missin: Add a Microsoft Client ID in Settings or provide it through the environment before continuing.
home.accounts.microsoft.flow_hint: The main thread should handle the callback and complete token exchange.
home.accounts.microsoft.device_placehold: Optional device-code note or callback hint
home.accounts.microsoft.device_hint: This area is a placeholder for authorization state and errors.
home.accounts.third_party.description: Reserves the form structure and role selection for Authlib-Injector / Yggdrasil.
home.accounts.third_party.summary: Use this with external auth servers. Make sure the server address and authlib-injector runtime are ready first.
home.accounts.third_party.flow_summary: Server, username, password and role selection are all reserved.
home.accounts.third_party.preview_body: This area will hold the third-party server metadata and role state.
home.accounts.third_party.server_hint: Only the site address is required. Zeperion Launcher will resolve and probe the Yggdrasil endpoints automatically.
home.accounts.third_party.roles_hint: This reserves the role picker for the server response later.
home.accounts.third_party.runtime_ready_: authlib-injector.jar is already available in runtime/, so third-party sign-in can proceed.
home.accounts.third_party.runtime_missin: Import authlib-injector.jar from Settings before continuing with third-party sign-in.
home.accounts.coming_soon: This account type is still under development. The add flow will be completed in this dialog later.
